boundary: Edge of the new August 2026 lava field: coherence loss where fresh lava buried the ground (from the Valle del Leone vents down the floor of the uninhabited Valle del Bove to fronts at ~1,315-1,340 m around Rocca Capra) versus undisturbed ground. Per INGV, no inhabited town was reached by lava. The towns on the lower east flank (Zafferana Etnea) got ash, not lava.
